background: CaixaBank is Spain's largest domestic bank by loans and deposits, formed from the la Caixa savings bank and its takeover of Bankia, with a retail, insurance and asset-management franchise concentrated in Spain and Portugal.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, A+ on average and the weakest of them at A, all on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 8 Jul 2026. Liquidity is the strength, with LCR of 193% and NSFR of 143% both in the top quarter of EU and Nordic banks, though LCR has fallen 14 points and NSFR 6 points since 30 Jun 2025. Capital is the weak spot, with CET1 of 12.3% in the bottom quarter and leverage of 5.5% below the median, both broadly flat. The flagged news, the newest on 4 Oct 2026, is all positive, on record profits.
